block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Master Input Sub-Domain Manifest orchestrating action bindings, keyboard hotkeys, and controller profiles.
what_it_enables: Decoupled symbolic action mappings for tactical movement, stance switches, and UI navigation
Configurable keyboard and mouse hotkey slots with primary and secondary bindings
Standard gamepad controller mappings, thumbstick axes, and deadzone thresholds
Key repeat delay and rate policies for crisp tactical grid navigation
Zero dynamic heap allocations during input event resolution (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across input configuration (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
All action binding profiles must be 5-block compliant and statically verifiable
Essential navigation actions must always possess at least one primary binding

profiles.title: Default Keyboard & Mouse Action Bindings
profiles.description: Standard QWERTY / Arrow keys action bindings, repeat rate, and system hotkeys.

profiles.title: Standard Gamepad & Controller Profile
profiles.description: Controller button mappings, D-pad navigation, shoulder triggers, and analog deadzones.
